posts.topic_title: So... Which black paint for backing ?
posts.author: HoloM
posts.post_subject: So... Which black paint for backing ?
posts.content_md:
Nice,

so I would not recommend water based backing 

as it will swell the emulsion and the image might vanish at least while it is not dry. But maybe it also damages the hologram or alters color.

Anway I would recommend to laminate it with a self adhesive black foil, as it is a dry process and easily applied .
